title: Open Org strategy
description: An organisation's strategy — themes, period, status, summary. A thin discovery schema for the Murmurations index; the full strategy is fetched via open_org_strategy_url. See https://openorg.good-ship.co.uk for context.

linked_schemas.title: Linked Schemas
linked_schemas.description: Identifies the schemas the strategy is published against.

org_id_guide.title: org-id.guide identifier
org_id_guide.description: The organisation's identifier in org-id.guide format (e.g. GB-CHC-1234567).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name for the strategy (from summary or slug).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Open Org theme keys describing what the strategy addresses.

period_start.title: Period start
period_start.description: Start date of the strategy period.

period_end.title: Period end
period_end.description: End date of the strategy period.

schema_version.title: Open Org schema version
schema_version.description: Version of the Open Org strategy schema.

open_org_strategy_url.title: Open Org strategy URL
open_org_strategy_url.description: URL of the full strategy JSON, served by the organisation's host.

schema.name: open_org_strategy-v0.1.0
schema.purpose: Federated discovery of organisation strategies. Funders and partners can find strategies by theme and status.
